rust.intro: Mods shipped as Rust source code are built on this computer when the game loads them. That takes Rust's compiler (rustc) and build tool (cargo). rustup installs both and keeps them up to date.
rust.no_toolchain: rustup is installed, but no toolchain is set up.
rust.step_check: Then press Check again. The launcher finds a fresh install without a restart.
rust.step_default: Set up the stable toolchain in a terminal:
rust.title: Install Rust
rust.unix_step2: 2. Take the default install. A distribution's rustc package is often too old for mods.
rust.win_or: Or install rustup from a terminal:
rust.win_step2: 2. Run it and take the default install. When it offers the Visual Studio C++ build tools, let it install them.
settings.java_note: Used by Java instances that set nothing of their own.
settings.keep_open_note: The launcher stays next to the game and can stop it.

share.copy_tip: Copy from the shared folder once
share.link_tip: Link this folder into the shared folder
share.options_tip: Play with the shared folder's options.txt
shared.delete_tip: Deletes the folder with everything in it
shared.folder_tip: Where this instance's linked folders and shared options live
shared.global_fixed: global is the default and always stays
shared.in_use: Still in use: switch its instances to another shared folder first
shared.note: Shared folders sit next to the instances and are laid out like one. Each instance uses one of them and links its worlds, resource packs, mods, plugins and options into it, or copies from it once. Use separate ones for modded play or older versions, for example.
welcome.account_note: Sign in with the Microsoft account that owns Minecraft, or with another service such as Ely.by, LittleSkin or Drasl, to play on online servers. An offline profile is enough for single player and offline servers.
welcome.client_note: Melon takes its textures, sounds and language files from your own Minecraft %s client jar. Use the jar of your own installation: it requires that you own Minecraft.
welcome.no_jar: No Minecraft %s client found. Start %s once in the official launcher and search again, or choose the jar.
welcome.sub: Two short steps. You can change both later in the settings.
welcome.title: Welcome to Melon
